data.content_ref: inline:The reliability of the panel integrates the 'Checklist-Task Fit' (SRC_005) by operating as a low-pass filter: the panel removes high-frequency individual noise (heuristics) while the checklist provides the signal. This relation is refuted if the panel's collective variance is found to be higher than the expert's variance in open-world tasks, as this would prove the checklist-panel integration fails when the task-fit is poor.
